limitations: No real-browser layout test; the deterministic DOM behavior and exported static figures are checked separately.
Semantic groupings have differing granularity. The graph is a documented proof route, not a theorem-count metric or a minimal dependency claim.

Primary source PDFs, full extractions and boundary-reading excerpts remain private and are not exports.
